description: Preview task for a Merkle root verifier that requires hash-function security and root equality evidence.

atoms.name: verify_merkle_root
atoms.description: Accept a Merkle proof only when the hash function is marked secure and the computed path equals the expected root.
atoms.requires: root >= 0 && leaf >= 0 && sibling_hash >= 0 && expected_root >= 0 && hash_function_secure == 1 && leaf + sibling_hash == expected_root && root == expected_root
